coverage_clause: G7.1 and G7.2 are ENFORCEMENT CONFIRMATIONS and are excluded from any 'gates seen failing' tally, per the validation document's own clause. G7.6 joins them: the shipped decoder and the grammar accept the same language, so it can only fall when G7.2 has already fallen. G7.7/G7.8 CANNOT move at N=600: V7.a needs 10 strata carrying 100 records and 600 records cannot fill more than 6. G7.10 was seen failing in its OWN job (the off-by-one oracle perturbation, 2026-08-22) and is read here from its artefact, not re-scored. G7.12 rises when work item 7.2 writes throughput_comparison.md.
